name: @sorarisu/dsh-drawio
description: draw.io diagrams for DeepSeek Harness: an agent tool that writes .drawio files, plus a sidebar panel with an embedded draw.io editor and an offline SVG preview.

permissions.filesystem: read-write within registered DSH workspaces only (.drawio files)
permissions.network: local loopback HTTP routes for the panel; the embedded editor iframe loads https://embed.diagrams.net (draw.io official embed build) — diagram data never leaves the browser and the local Host

author: Nvoyo
